notes:
BUILD 75
- The hands on the wheel are the same hands that hold your gun: proper fingers closed round the rim (or the bike's grips), your own sleeves and gloves, an arm behind each.
- The driver sits on the seat instead of in it, and looking down no longer shows the inside of your own arms.
- Tyres are solid from every side.
- Engine quality matters much more to how hard a car pulls (low quality about a third weaker than regular, high quality about 40% stronger) and a little to top speed: about 10 km/h between an all-low and an all-high engine.
- Helicopter hatches: the minicopter's is just ENGINE. The transport and attack helicopters open on the engine, with a button to switch to the cargo.
